metadata.title: Micron is closing in on Apple and Microsoft on this key metric - MarketWatch

content.text:
16 hours ago
Micron is closing in on Apple and Microsoft on this key metric
Micron posted $33.3 billion in operating income for the most recent quarter, meaning that it's closing in on some heavyweights.
For context, Apple had operating income of $35.9 billion in its most recently reported quarter. Microsoft posted $38.4 billion on the metric and Alphabet recorded $39.9 billion, according to FactSet data compiled by Dow Jones Market Data.
Micron is seeing far more dramatic improvements in operating income on a sequential basis, as it essentially doubled its performance on the metric in just three months. By comparison, Alphabet saw an almost $4 billion sequential increase, while Microsoft's performance was roughly flat and Apple actually saw operating income meaningfully decline relative to three months before.
